look_here_first: Texas sweet Indian mallow: small yellow 5-petal mallow flower, small hairy heart-based leaves, and a compact dry fruit with about 6–9(–10) unspined mericarps. For A. incanum lookalike count 6–9 style branches instead of 5. DO NOT require a hairless staminal tube: FNA and UT/Kew disagree.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays and Travis remain supported target-zone occurrences. The earlier Williamson record is outside the project target zone, so this taxon is retained in the learner with range unresolved rather than relabeled as confirmed target-zone native.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Learner admission is source-pool based; do not count this entry in confirmed-native metrics unless a third valid target-zone county is later documented.

best_field_traits: Compact 6–9(–10)-mericarp schizocarp with short, not long-spined segment tips
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Separate from velvetleaf (A. theophrasti) by the smaller leaves and compact fruit; separate from A. incanum by plain yellow flowers and more style branches.
morphology_keys.flower: 5 yellow or yellow-orange petals, 5–10 mm long (FNA). Style commonly 6–9 branches. FNA reports glabrous staminal column, but detailed Texas material says some stellate hairs and Kew treatments report hair; do not rely on absence of hair.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Schizocarp cask-shaped, 8–9 × 8–9 mm; mericarp apex acute/apiculate, tomentulose; 3 seeds per mericarp, seeds ~2 mm.

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. fruticosum has about 6–9 style branches (usually corresponding to 6–9, sometimes 10, fruit segments) versus A. incanum 5; historic Texas reports of A. incanum often represent fruticosum. Velvetleaf has 13–15 styles and many 3–6 mm long-pointed mericarps. Column pubescence is disputed between authoritative floras; not a strict distinction.

field_diagnostics.single_best_trait: 6–9 style/stigma branches and corresponding 6–9(–10) unspined mericarps in a compact fruit; compare 5 in A. incanum.
fastest_traits: Staminal column hair CONTRADICTORY across FNA (glabrous), UT Austin (some stellate hairs), Kew (hairy); not decisive

look_alikes.distinction: A. incanum has 5 style branches, whereas A. fruticosum typically has 6–9; reports of Texas A. incanum may be misidentifications. Column hair is not a reliable binary because botanical treatments conflict.
Velvetleaf is annual with very large 8–15 cm leaves, 13–15 style branches and a much larger 15 × 20 mm fruit with long 3–6 mm divergent spines.

diagnostic_photo_targets: Flower-center macro showing glabrous staminal column and style branches
Mature fruit top showing 6–9(–10) mericarp segments clearly counted
A visible stigma branch/count shot; annotations NOT on yellow anthers
